caption: Psalm 22 says the sufferer prays by day and night. It does not predict daytime darkness or three hours—those details come entirely from Matthew.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Psalm 22 predict Calvary’s darkness? The psalmist cries to God by day and by night. Matthew reports three hours of darkness during the crucifixion.
slides.body: The psalmist cries to God by day and by night. Matthew reports three hours of darkness during the crucifixion.
slides.heading: Did Psalm 22 predict Calvary’s darkness?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Ps 22:2: I cry out by day … and by night, but I have no rest.
